title: Audiological testing
description: Audiological testing measures your hearing ability and identifies any hearing loss. During this outpatient exam, you'll sit in a soundproof booth and listen to tones at different volumes and frequencies, raising your hand when you hear sounds. Your doctor may also perform speech recognition tests and check how your eardrums respond to sound. Results help determine if you have hearing loss, what type it is, and whether you need hearing aids or other treatment. The tests are painless and take 30-60 minutes.
